subject: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alisha Verma <alisha.verma@sagesys.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim

Hi Alisha —

Thanks again for the sprint on onboarding. I pulled your intake packet and noticed a couple missing fields that block PO assignment in our system:
- Missing tax registration number on page 2
- No explicit billing contact phone number
- The SKU list references two consolidated line items but our onboarding requires per-sku unit prices for PO mapping

We can proceed with a provisional PO but procurement needs the corrected onboarding form to: 1) set the spend cap correctly and 2) map line items so our ledger matches invoices. Can you re-submit the onboarding PDF with the fields filled and, if possible, a CSV of the SKU breakout?

Ask: please reply with the completed form by EOD Tuesday so we can avoid delaying the PO window. If you need a provisional PO to start work we can request one, but it will require procurement approval for temporary spend access.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachment: —
From: Alisha Verma <alisha.verma@sagesys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim

Hi Ben / team —

Thanks for the heads up. Sorry about the oversight — attached is the updated onboarding packet with the tax details and billing phone filled in. I've also attached a quick CSV that breaks the consolidated SKU into three line items with unit pricing.

We do need the provisional PO to kick off the initial integration work next week. If procurement can provision interim access (even a capped provisional amount) that will let our engineers begin.

Attachment: Sage_Onboarding_Form.pdf (updated), sage_sku_breakdown.csv

Best,
Alisha Verma
Vendor Ops, Sage Systems
alisha.verma@sagesys.com | +1 512-555-4290
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-09T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim

Thanks Alisha — form looks complete now and the CSV helps. A couple of procurement notes before we issue:
1) Spend cap: Sage requested $150k annual. We need to split the initial provisioning into a provisional tranche of $15k for integration + the remaining spend band to be gated until full vendor accreditation (SOC2 evidence) completes.
2) Line-item mapping: The SKU CSV should map to our internal ledger codes. I created a draft mapping but we will need the vendor to confirm the SKU-to-PO description matches their invoice headers. I attached the draft mapping as a CSV for your review.
3) PO number: we can issue a provisional PO for the $15k tranche today if Finance signs off on the temporary cap. To proceed I need a signed SOW or written confirmation that Sage accepts the provisional cap and the milestone that will trigger the next tranche release.

Please review the attached line-item map and confirm acceptance. Once Sage signs the acceptance I will escalate to Finance for provisional PO issuance.

Attachment: PO-784512-lineitem-map.csv

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Alisha Verma <alisha.verma@sagesys.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim

Monica — thanks for the clear path. Forwarding Sage's confirmation below from earlier (they attached the updated packet) — Alisha, can you please: 
- Sign the one-paragraph confirmation that you accept the $15k provisional tranche and milestone A (integration complete) as the trigger for the next release
- Confirm that invoice headers will use the exact descriptions in the attached PO-784512-lineitem-map.csv

If you sign, I will mark this PR as approved from Sales side and Priyom can submit the Finance ticket for provisional PO issuance. Time is a bit constrained — the integration team is ready to begin Monday if we can get access.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: intake form gaps, PO tagging, and spend-cap reclaim

Hi all — quick update from Finance / PO ops:

1) Provisional PO issued: PO-784512 (provisional) for $15,000 has been created and attached. This is a provisional tranche only and will be subject to the milestones Monica outlined.
2) Line items: I attached the official provisional PO PDF and included the PO-784512-lineitem-map.csv entries in the PO description. Alisha — please confirm invoice headers will match these descriptions exactly or request the change now; mismatches will delay invoice processing.
3) Spend cap reclaim: we've set the remaining $135,000 as a gated band. To release additional tranches Finance requires:
   - SOC2 Type II evidence uploaded to our portal (you can upload to the Drive link shared)
   - Signed SOW or email confirmation from Sage that milestone A acceptance criteria is met

Next steps: Alisha — sign and return the short acceptance note below, confirm invoice headers, and upload SOC2 evidence when available. Once we have that I'll convert the provisional PO to a standard PO and un-gate the remaining spend.

Acceptance note (paste-and-sign): "Sage Systems accepts the provisional PO-784512 for $15,000 for integration work and confirms the milestone A acceptance criteria as documented in the attached SOW. Invoice headers will match the PO line descriptions provided."

Attachment: provisional_po_PO-784512.pdf

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
